text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had a secret goal for today. That was 
because—
choice_data_list:
(I have to see Mar-chan's entrance no 
matter what!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Up until now, I hadn't been able to 
properly see her off for the races she had 
set as her major goals.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Keep my eyes on her, and follow her the 
moment she stands up. With that secret 
resolve, I turn my gaze toward her—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just as expected, they weren't there.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
All pumped up, full of excitement. I feel 
like... I might be in peak condition 
today.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...? You seem to be in quite a rush. Did 
something happen?
choice_data_list: I wanted to see you off.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I want to see them off. ...?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, of course. You've always been so 
dedicated to your work, Trainer.
choice_data_list:
No, it's not so much that I'm hardworking 
as...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I don't know how to explain it to her. 
Though, it really does seem like she just 
doesn't understand.
choice_data_list:
When something big happens to you, I want 
to be right there by your side.

When it's an important moment for you, I 
want to be by your side.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: A major crisis for Chan.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Even though it's a matter of life and 
death for Machan?
choice_data_list: Because it's a crisis for Chan.
Because it's a crisis for you, Chan.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Is that how it is?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The mystery surrounding you, Trainer, has 
only deepened.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
One step forward, and one step back. This 
is quite a predicament.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
This is troubling, but... For now, I must 
go.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I'll clear it from my mind for now.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'm heading out.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan looked back at me several 
times as she—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Chan, have a safe trip." "Yes, Chan is 
heading off now."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Take care. ...——I'm off.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She headed toward the Sprinters Stakes.
